string.text: Near a lit campfire, body and limbs heal on separate timers. Body: 20% every N seconds (applied as +1% steps). Limbs: convert 1 BHS point of existing temp→perm every N seconds on the lowest-HP limb (campfire never applies temp). No caps. Disable Campfire slowly regens life (arti).
Seconds for body HP to gain 20% (30-100). Applied smoothly as +1% every (this / 20) seconds.
Seconds between converting 1 BHS point (~20% on arms/legs) of temp into permanent on the lowest-HP limb that still has temp (20-100).
